errors.error: AssertionError: only raw console and caller stdin os.write sites
errors.cause: Reader compared ast.walk traversal order with lexical declaration order. ast.walk yielded the same two allowed sites in a different order.
errors.correction: Compare the two allowed target expressions as an unordered set and retain the exact count.

errors.error: root close before compact console false predicate
errors.cause: Global substring matched the emit_once declaration before main, rather than its call.
errors.correction: Compare actual os.close and emit_once Call nodes inside main by source line.

errors.error: AssertionError at unrestricted git diff --quiet after editing owned staged README
errors.cause: Reader compared worktree with index including the owned folder. The new README update was intentionally not staged yet.
errors.correction: Compare authorized parent against worktree and index with the owned new folder excluded. Final commit tree difference must also contain only additions inside that folder.

errors.error: non-patch whitespace assertion after staging raw diagnostic transcript
errors.cause: The raw diagnostic text reproduced the patch context spaces, so it also had trailing-space diagnostics.
errors.correction: Retain the exact transcript as a JSON UTF-8 string with reversible escapes; remove only the new uncommitted plain-text duplicate.
